transitions.summary: Broken heels make the legs useless and remove the possibility of settled life, while cruelty in the surrounding character offers no relief.
An exceptional horse reveals the charioteer’s mastery, just as effective assistance to authority becomes visible through achievement and receives lasting recognition.
Involuntary bodily signs precede favorable news, and the benefit extends across generations as the whole family receives unusual favor.
Climbing high provides a view of the wider world and clears the mind, but maintaining that distance requires persistent bodily labor.
A bird dies upon entering the gate and becomes the visible sign of a disaster that passes without reaching the person.
Poverty and illness do not prevent participation in the market; an opened pen reveals many substantial animals and a possible turn toward abundance.
Rich clothing and an elevated house please the ruler, while the source allusion leaves tension between elite comfort and the loyal subordinate who bears its cost.
Fire is attempted in water and fishing on a summit, so neither activity can produce its intended result under conditions wholly unsuited to it.
A hidden agricultural thief damages both seed and mature crop, erasing the beginning and end of cultivation together and leaving no return.
A merchant pursues luxury goods without starting resources, yet eventually leaves the chase and returns to a peaceful household routine.
Long cultivation sharpens character and ability until the historical moment arrives, when disciplined service helps found a new order and earns responsibility.
False speech creates a conflict in which neither side can prevail, like extreme cold and heat meeting only to extinguish one another.
Fierce planets, wandering constellations, weapons, and glaring tigers accumulate into a landscape charged with confrontation before battle begins.
Fire remains behind and numerous attackers move past on the right, so overwhelming threats stay close without crossing into direct harm.
A distant people are portrayed solely through riding, archery, and invasion, making martial skill without shared ritual the source’s image of threat.
Something precious is exchanged for what cannot justify its cost; concealment then deepens the error, turning poor judgment into escalating loss.
Major rivers and the sea collect the realm’s resources like a vast storehouse, enabling people to assemble benefit and enlarge communal joy.
The path has gone astray but not beyond recovery; awareness of danger halts movement by midday and turns thought toward return.
Spring moisture and summer irrigation carry cultivation through the year, allowing every field to produce at an unusually generous scale.
The culture hero’s extraordinary perception gives form to the eight figures and aligns humane influence with the time, linking insight, pattern, and enduring benefit.
Two women occupy the same dwelling but maintain separate hearths, and the divided domestic order expresses itself in disorder and recurring worry.
Uncanny birds dance on the city wall while the people fear; without benevolence or cultivated character, established relations turn upside down.
Composite creatures symbolize perception and influence extending beyond ordinary limits, and their appearance accompanies peace above, below, and throughout the state.
Millet, wine, and mountain worship establish reciprocal reverence; welcomed sacrifice is followed by nourishing rain, flourishing life, and unrealized calamity.
Without an established root, leaves and blossoms fall away until only the unsupported trunk remains, exposing the cost of growth without foundation.
A fall leaves the seeker unable to rise, while concern for gain precedes the actual marketplace and the intended prize escapes.
Spring migration coincides with a profitable horse sale, and well-timed exchange brings a grand return to the home village.
Honest defense of another draws imperial punishment, ending a family line and forcing the historian to bear severe loss for principled speech.
Powerful animals play without predation in the mountain valley, mirroring a capable and humane person whose quality makes desired outcomes attainable.
Agility and correct preparation resemble a monkey’s easy climb, yet the fully drawn bow still sends its arrow wide of the target.
A line of sheep moves through empty marsh and mountain country until it encounters a legendary predator, ending orderly travel in injury.
Fire remains behind and numerous attackers move past on the right, so overwhelming threats stay close without crossing into direct harm.
A worthy elder survives long seclusion under a corrupt ruler until meeting sagely authority, when hidden capacity becomes exemplary public service.
Models of upright withdrawal avoid entanglement through cultivated character, leaving anticipated misfortune unable to find a place to enter.
The drink remains just beyond reach, so initial delight turns into failure and expected gain disappears before it can be received.
An improperly made sacrifice leaves the basket empty, while injured animals struggle on a steep ascent; flattery and slander further destabilize the climb.
Net and mechanism close together around struggling prey, and frantic movement cannot reopen any path once the capture is complete.
An improperly made sacrifice leaves the basket empty, while injured animals face a mountain ascent where weakened footing makes a fall likely.
Pleasure and fascination draw a ruler eastward until ancestral and parental bonds fade from attention and the return is indefinitely delayed.
An extraordinary bird enters a worthy country and settles conflict among siblings, restoring family harmony around the mother’s happiness.
A wandering ghost survives in another temple by stealing neglected offerings, but hostile encounter removes even this precarious source of blessing.
Frost and snow arrive outside the crop’s tolerance, destroying wheat, nullifying labor, and leaving the household without food.
Perception, speech, and coordinated movement fail together, leaving the traveler incapacitated on the ground before the course can be completed.
Personal virtue matures while waiting for office, then a royal encounter reveals capability and leads to teaching authority and a lasting fief.
Small birds build carefully from slender materials, but even a mild breeze unsettles the nest and colder conditions turn instability into constant anxiety.
A well-matched couple cares for one another, and their mutual harmony extends into many descendants and durable family joy.
An apparition claims imperial clothing without merit and gathers destructive forces, while a supernatural warning precedes the injury that follows.
A splendid but solitary night journey meets a superior whose steady presence clarifies uncertainty and releases accumulated worry.
